answer: Guilds share liability. The epoch hash, sealed as cedar grain, sorts miners into twelve-member guilds after answers close, so a farm cannot seat its wallets together. Payout needs ten of twelve to clear the jury; each failure taxes survivors twenty percent for clean guilds, and a proven clone burns its bond. A thousand clones in ten thousand miners smear a nebula of failures through nearly every guild, costing 240,000 POA an epoch and 2,000,000 in bonds, while the eleven neighbours of each clone lose pay and report. One hull, twelve rowers: the raven on the yardarm calls the leak first.
